text:
Emilia: Thanks for the runtime deep dive — a few follow-ups from the product/roadmap side: 1) what's the kernel v4 rollout timeline? 2) will telemetry expose per-kernel latency histograms and kv-cache metrics? 3) any short notes we can hand to PMs about fallback routing behavior?

Ryan: Good questions. Canary is targeted next week; broader rollout depends on canary health but tentatively mid-May. Aisha will confirm telemetry details.

Aisha: Confirming canary start 2025-05-07. Telemetry plan: per-kernel p50/p95/p99, per-seq-length buckets, and kv-cache hit/miss rates. We'll also surface per-node memory metrics for kernels.

Mark: For fallback routing — Console will show active routing policy + model variant health. If you need immediate data, you can query routing state via the control API, e.g.:

`GET /api/v1/routing?model=redwood-kernel-v4`

Tash: Quick perf note: kernel v4 changes attention memory patterns. For latency-sensitive workloads prefer microbatch sizes 16 or 32; large batch sizes still win for throughput. I'll post a short guidance doc with numbers.

Victor: Will the per-kernel histograms feed our SLO alerts? I'm worried about p99 noise when small tenants spike.

Aisha: We'll wire p99 into alerting but use dynamic thresholds per-tenant and short-window smoothing to avoid noisy on-call pages. Also adding an aggregation layer for multi-tenant signals.

sre-bot: Incident 2025-05-09T03:21 — Canary rollout paused: increased OOM rate observed on some 80G nodes. Investigating memory spikes in kernel v4.

Ryan: Thanks — status? Aisha, any immediate mitigations we can use while you investigate?

Aisha: Short-term mitigation: reduce default batch_size to 16 on 80G pools and temporarily divert traffic to v3 variants for heavy tails. Long-term: patch kernel to reduce transient KV allocations; ETA for patch rollout ~48 hours.

Emilia: PM ask: can we get a one-page summary that maps kernel variant -> expected latency tiers, cost-per-token, and recommended batch sizes? They want it for the roadmap doc.

Mark: I'll assemble the 1-pager with cost and throughput numbers (estimated cost / token, p50/p95 under recommended batch sizes). Will link here when ready.

Tash: I'll include microbatch guidance and examples (e.g., "use batch_size=16 for <200ms median at 512-seq on 80G"). Also a note that quantized variants shift the sweet spot.

Ryan: Action items: Aisha to confirm canary start + memory mitigation plan; Mark to produce the latency/cost 1-pager; Tash to publish microbatch recommendations and perf table. We'll recap at next eng sync.

Emilia: Perfect — please ping back here with links/docs. :thumbsup:
